_comment: Canonical frontmatter schema for plan-artifact files under ${PLANS_DIR}. Enforced via R-40 in pre-write-guard.sh. ADDRESS CONVERGENCE: the plans tree is governed by this schema's R-40 advisory lane at BOTH of its addresses — the physical plans-root path and the vault-view Plans/ symlink spelling. The vault 3-tier schema gate does not apply to the plans tree at either address; the guard's PLANS_ADDR_CONV prelude canonicalizes a vault-view spelling to the physical path (the canonical addressing key), so no path spelling produces a different verdict for the same file.

manifest._note: manifest.json is JSON, not Markdown. Validated structurally at the top-level JSON keys rather than as YAML frontmatter. The R-40 advisory skips manifest.json files; existing validate-manifest.sh and /librarian plan-index Read-side parsing cover the JSON-structural checks.
